basics.name: Abhishek Reddy Malreddy
basics.summary: Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence Engineering (Materials Science and Engineering) at Carnegie Mellon University

highlights: Developed the IDD-AW dataset (5,000 RGB-NIR images) for semantic segmentation under adverse weather.
Introduced the “Safe mIoU” metric to better penalize safety-critical misclassifications.
Simulated congested traffic in SUMO and trained reinforcement-learning agents to optimize emergency vehicle routes.
Optimized incident database workflows, improving SLA compliance and resolution speed.
Collaborated cross-functionally to analyze trends and streamline incident-management processes.
Built a decentralized transaction management system with public-key identifiers and timestamp propagation.
Engineered a configurable simulation framework for real-time transaction queuing and processing.

portfolio.name: TrackAnything: Multi-modal Promptable Tracking in 3D
portfolio.description: Generated 3D bounding boxes from text prompts and video using Argoverse 2 and a transformer-based model. Fused LiDAR, map and pose data to improve scenario mining in autonomous driving. Enhanced urban object-tracking accuracy for downstream safety analyses.

portfolio.name: Real-time Pedestrian Detection and Safety Alert System
portfolio.description: Built an edge-AI safety system on Jetson Nano using YOLO & MobileNet SSD trained on CityPersons/Caltech. Optimized inference with quantization, pruning, and TensorRT via DeepStream. Implemented audio-visual alerts and flashing lights for real-time pedestrian/bicycle safety.

portfolio.name: FIFA Player Analysis and Performance Prediction
portfolio.description: Unified multi-year FIFA player data in PostgreSQL, enabling PySpark-based analytics. Developed GBT, RF, and MLP models, reducing RMSE by 30% in performance predictions.
